summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of TSB Banking Group, plc. The acquisition closed on April 30, 2026, on terms previously announced in July 2025. No additional deal terms (price per share, premium, consideration type) are provided in this filing. The board recommendation was not reiterated. The filing confirms the transaction has closed, so no regulatory clock remains. What to watch: integration execution and any future disclosures regarding synergies or restructuring.
